propositions: An integration harness must extend test_reconcile_idempotency.py to seed out-of-window and deleted key sets on the fake Jira client so that out-of-window-but-alive keys and 404-deleted keys reach clear_absent and note_absent callsites during reconcile passes.

The test harness must pre-register reconcile_run_differs and monkeypatch its _load_reconcile_backend to wire JiraBackend(fake_transport) so that the mutation oracle observes the real binding-lifecycle code path driven by reconciliation, not a mock.

An out-of-window-alive key passing through reconciliation must reach clear_absent exactly once, compute zero mutations, issue zero Jira writes, leave updated_at untouched (change-gate oracle), and preserve bindings.json bytes and tracker HEAD across repeated identical passes.

A 404-then-alive round-trip must record absence via note_absent with a frozen lifecycle clock sentinel (proving the 02c4 clock fix reaches the moved module), then clear_absent must reset the absence counter (clearing branch oracle), pinning tombstone-side siblings at integration tier.
